Amit Shah inaugurates India's first immersive language museum in Kolkata

Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated India's first immersive language museum, the 'Museum of Words', in Kolkata. The museum features 22 languages and 9 digital galleries, aiming to showcase India's linguistic diversity. The inauguration highlights efforts to preserve and promote India's rich heritage of languages.
